title: Boundary rectifiability for a compactly supported integer multiplicity (m+2)-current of finite mass in ℝ^P (Simon 6.3 via 6.2 and 8.2; Simon 3.14 in codimension zero)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ with m + 1 < P, and let R ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P) be an integer multiplicity current with compact support, M(R) < ∞ and M(∂R) < ∞ (M = mass = M_{ℝ^P}). Then ∂R ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)), m + 1 < P → IsIntegerMultiplicity R → IsCompact R.support → R.mass < ∞ → R.boundary.mass < ∞ → IsIntegerMultiplicity R.boundary
